title: Celebrity – Sour Worms 60ml
description:
Celebrity – Sour Worms 60ml
Introducing Celebrity Eliquid, where indulgence meets sophistication in every inhale. Delve into a world of tangy delight with our Sour Worms flavor—a playful yet refined fusion crafted to elevate your vaping experience.
Unveil the tantalizing blend of zesty citrus and fruity sweetness, harmoniously entwined with a subtle kick of sourness. Each puff immerses you in a symphony of flavors reminiscent of your favorite childhood treats, now exquisitely tailored for a more refined palate.
The Celebrity Eliquid in Sour Worms flavor is meticulously concocted to deliver a smooth, satisfying vape, boasting a perfect balance between tangy and sweet notes. Every cloud exudes an aroma that evokes nostalgia while embracing a contemporary twist, making it a go-to choice for aficionados seeking a sophisticated vaping adventure.
60ml Bottle
0mg Strength
PG30/VG70
